resources.string: Shows ongoing Regonex screen recording status and controls
Captures game audio, music, and internal sound
Records your voice with noise suppression
No recordings yet. Tap the red button to record your screen!
Are you sure you want to permanently delete this screen recording? This cannot be undone.
Allow microphone access so you can add voice commentary or turn your microphone on at any moment during recording. You can still record screen video with app audio if you prefer.
Tap button to turn microphone on or off
Muted by default; records only while holding button
Microphone is disabled because permission was not granted. Tap to open Settings and allow access.
Regonex Recorder automatically pauses recording during calls so private phone conversations are never captured.
Regonex Recorder can silence notifications and banners while recording so your video is clean and uninterrupted.
Records teammate voices from phone speaker via microphone while playing. Requires speaker playback.

Note: Android blocks internal recording of voice communication for non-root apps. Teammates\' voices cannot be captured through headphones or earbuds. Play sound through the phone speaker to record both voices.
To prevent Android system battery optimization from silencing audio or interrupting long gameplay recordings, allow Regonex Recorder to run unrestricted in the background.
Are you sure you want to permanently delete all %1$d screen recordings? This action cannot be undone.
